# system.playNumber

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Play a number using the current locale.

```lua
system.playNumber(value[, unit[, decimals[, voice[, priority]]]])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | number | yes |  |
| `unit` | number | optional (default `is 0`) |  |
| `decimals` | number | optional (default `is 0`) |  |
| `voice` | number | optional (default `is 0`) |  |
| `priority` | number | optional (default `is 0`) |  |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua
system.playNumber(11.8, UNIT_VOLT, 1)       -- "eleven point eight volts"
system.playNumber(75, UNIT_PERCENT, 0)      -- "seventy five percent"

-- speak a source with its own unit and precision
local src = system.getSource({ category = CATEGORY_SYSTEM, member = MAIN_VOLTAGE })
if src then system.playNumber(src:value(), src:unit(), src:decimals()) end
```
